answer: WITH enc AS ( SELECT e.pat_ref, e.enc_key, e.time_mark, e.miss_appt, asd.rec_status, (CASE asd.funcassess->>'Soc_Sup' WHEN 'Strong' THEN 3 WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE asd.funcassess->>'Rel_Qual' WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 2 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sse FROM encounters e JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd ON asd.asd_key = e.ab_ref ), stable AS ( SELECT DISTINCT e.pat_ref FROM enc e JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key JOIN treatmentoutcomes t ON t.tx_ref = tb.tx_key WHERE e.rec_status = 'Stable' AND lower(t.txprogmet->>'Func_Impv') IN ('moderate','significant') ), pat AS ( SELECT pat_ref, AVG(miss_appt) AS avg_missed_appointments FROM encounters GROUP BY pat_ref ), latest AS ( SELECT pat_ref, sse, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pat_ref ORDER BY time_mark DESC, enc_key DESC) AS rn FROM enc ) SELECT DISTINCT s.pat_ref AS patient_id, p.avg_missed_appointments, l.sse AS most_recent_sse FROM stable s JOIN pat p ON p.pat_ref = s.pat_ref JOIN latest l ON l.pat_ref = s.pat_ref AND l.rn = 1 WHERE p.avg_missed_appointments > 2 OR l.sse < 3
note: SSE: Soc_Sup data holds 'Moderate' (not in the definition) and NULLs, scored 0. 'Most recent' uses encounter time_mark, which is identical for every encounter, so ties are broken by enc_key.

answer: WITH ce AS ( SELECT e.clin_id, e.fac_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.pat_ref) AS n_pat, SUM(e.miss_appt) AS tot_missed FROM encounters e JOIN facilities f ON f.fac_key = e.fac_id WHERE f.com_res IN ('Adequate','Comprehensive','Extensive') AND e.clin_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.clin_id, e.fac_id ), cc AS ( SELECT e.clin_id, e.fac_id, SUM(tb.crisis_int) AS tot_crisis FROM encounters e JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key GROUP BY e.clin_id, e.fac_id ), psm AS ( SELECT ce.clin_id, ce.fac_id, 1.0 / (1 + COALESCE(cc.tot_crisis,0)::numeric / NULLIF(ce.n_pat,0) + COALESCE(ce.tot_missed,0)::numeric / NULLIF(ce.n_pat,0)) AS psm FROM ce LEFT JOIN cc ON cc.clin_id = ce.clin_id AND cc.fac_id = ce.fac_id ) SELECT clin_id AS clinician_id, fac_id AS facility_id, ROUND(psm, 2) AS psm, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fac_id ORDER BY psm DESC) AS rank_in_facility FROM psm ORDER BY fac_id, rank_in_facility, clin_id LIMIT 100

WITH latest AS ( SELECT e.pat_ref, e.ab_ref, e.time_mark, e.fac_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.pat_ref ORDER BY e.time_mark DESC, e.enc_key DESC) AS rn FROM encounters e WHERE e.ab_ref IS NOT NULL ), tes AS ( SELECT e.pat_ref, AVG(CASE tb.th_eng WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 END) AS avg_tes FROM encounters e JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key GROUP BY e.pat_ref ) SELECT l.pat_ref AS patient_id, l.ab_ref AS assessment_id, l.time_mark AS assessment_date, ROUND(t.avg_tes, 2) AS avg_tes, CASE WHEN f.env_stress = 'Severe' THEN f.env_stress ELSE f.life_impact END AS stress_or_impact_level FROM latest l JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk r ON r.asr_key = l.ab_ref JOIN facilities f ON f.fac_key = l.fac_id JOIN tes t ON t.pat_ref = l.pat_ref WHERE l.rn = 1 AND (r.suic_risk = 'High' OR r.phq9_scr > 15 OR r.gad7_scr > 15) AND (f.env_stress = 'Severe' OR f.life_impact = 'Severe') AND t.avg_tes < 2 ORDER BY l.time_mark DESC, l.pat_ref LIMIT 50
note: All encounter timestamps are identical, so 'most recent' is a tie-break. The level column shows the facility's severe env_stress or life_impact value. TES rounded to 2 dp.

answer: WITH ep AS ( SELECT asd.prim_dx, e.pat_ref, e.enc_key FROM encounters e JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd ON asd.asd_key = e.ab_ref WHERE asd.prim_dx IS NOT NULL ), cr AS ( SELECT ep.prim_dx, SUM(tb.crisis_int) AS tot_crisis FROM ep JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = ep.enc_key GROUP BY ep.prim_dx ), pc AS ( SELECT prim_dx, COUNT(DISTINCT pat_ref) AS patient_count FROM ep GROUP BY prim_dx ) SELECT pc.prim_dx AS diagnosis, pc.patient_count, ROUND(COALESCE(cr.tot_crisis,0)::numeric / NULLIF(pc.patient_count,0), 2) AS cif FROM pc LEFT JOIN cr ON cr.prim_dx = pc.prim_dx ORDER BY cif DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT ROUND(6000.0 / (100 * 1.25), 2) AS affordable_therapy_hours, (split_part(ab.therapy_exp_intensity, ' ', 1)::numeric >= 30) AS meets_30h_target, ROUND(split_part(ab.treatment_cost_eff, ' ', 1)::numeric * 6000, 2) AS projected_qol_gain, (split_part(ab.treatment_cost_eff, ' ', 1)::numeric * 6000 > 650) AS exceeds_650_threshold FROM assessmentbasics ab WHERE ab.pat_owner_ref = 'P425079'

WITH tar AS ( SELECT e.fac_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.txprogmet->>'Tx_Adh' IN ('High','Medium','Compliant'))::numeric / COUNT(*) AS tar FROM treatmentoutcomes t JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.tx_key = t.tx_ref JOIN encounters e ON e.enc_key = tb.enc_ref GROUP BY e.fac_id ), res AS ( SELECT fac_key, CASE WHEN com_res IN ('Comprehensive','Extensive') THEN 3 WHEN com_res = 'Adequate' THEN 2 WHEN com_res = 'Limited' THEN 1 END AS res_score FROM facilities ) SELECT ROUND(CORR(r.res_score, t.tar)::numeric, 4) AS craa FROM tar t JOIN res r ON r.fac_key = t.fac_id

WITH pfis AS ( SELECT e.fac_id, AVG(CASE lower(asd.func_imp) WHEN 'severe' THEN 3 WHEN 'moderate' THEN 2 WHEN 'mild' THEN 1 END) AS pfis FROM encounters e JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd ON asd.asd_key = e.ab_ref GROUP BY e.fac_id ), frai AS ( SELECT fac_key AS fac_id, CASE WHEN com_res IN ('Comprehensive','Extensive') THEN 3 WHEN com_res = 'Adequate' THEN 2 WHEN com_res = 'Limited' THEN 1 END AS frai FROM facilities ), tes AS ( SELECT e.fac_id, AVG(CASE tb.th_eng WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 END) AS tes FROM encounters e JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key GROUP BY e.fac_id ), tar AS ( SELECT e.fac_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.txprogmet->>'Tx_Adh' IN ('High','Medium','Compliant'))::numeric / COUNT(*) AS tar FROM treatmentoutcomes t JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.tx_key = t.tx_ref JOIN encounters e ON e.enc_key = tb.enc_ref GROUP BY e.fac_id ), mar AS ( SELECT fac_id, SUM(miss_appt)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT pat_ref),0) AS mar FROM encounters GROUP BY fac_id ), m AS ( SELECT f.fac_id, p.pfis - f.frai AS rdd, (te.tes + ta.tar * 3) / 2 AS eas, mr.mar FROM frai f JOIN pfis p ON p.fac_id = f.fac_id JOIN tes te ON te.fac_id = f.fac_id JOIN tar ta ON ta.fac_id = f.fac_id JOIN mar mr ON mr.fac_id = f.fac_id ) SELECT fac_id AS facility_id, ROUND(rdd, 2) AS rdd FROM m WHERE rdd > 1.0 AND eas < 1.5 AND mar > 2.5 ORDER BY rdd DESC, fac_id LIMIT 100

SELECT ab.pat_owner_ref AS patient_id, asd.dx_dur_m, asd.prev_hosp, (split_part(ab.therapy_exp_intensity, ' ', 1)::numeric >= 15) AS meets_intensive_standard FROM assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd JOIN assessmentbasics ab ON ab.ab_key = asd.asd_key WHERE asd.prim_dx = 'Bipolar' AND asd.dx_dur_m >= 120 AND asd.prev_hosp > 3

WITH sym AS ( SELECT p.pat_eth, r.phq9_scr, r.gad7_scr FROM patients p JOIN assessmentbasics ab ON ab.pat_owner_ref = p.pat_key JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk r ON r.asr_key = ab.ab_key ), eng AS ( SELECT p.pat_eth, CASE tb.th_eng WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 END AS tes_val FROM patients p JOIN encounters e ON e.pat_ref = p.pat_key JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key ), adh AS ( SELECT p.pat_eth, CASE WHEN t.txprogmet->>'Tx_Adh' IN ('High','Medium','Compliant') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS adh_flag FROM patients p JOIN encounters e ON e.pat_ref = p.pat_key JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key JOIN treatmentoutcomes t ON t.tx_ref = tb.tx_key ), s AS ( SELECT pat_eth, (AVG(phq9_scr) + AVG(gad7_scr)) / 2 AS ssi FROM sym GROUP BY pat_eth UNION ALL SELECT 'All Ethnicities', (AVG(phq9_scr) + AVG(gad7_scr)) / 2 FROM sym ), te AS ( SELECT pat_eth, AVG(tes_val) AS tes FROM eng GROUP BY pat_eth UNION ALL SELECT 'All Ethnicities', AVG(tes_val) FROM eng ), ta AS ( SELECT pat_eth, AVG(adh_flag) AS tar FROM adh GROUP BY pat_eth UNION ALL SELECT 'All Ethnicities', AVG(adh_flag) FROM adh ) SELECT s.pat_eth AS patient_ethnicity, ROUND(s.ssi, 2) AS symptom_severity_index, ROUND((te.tes + ta.tar * 3) / 2, 2) AS engagement_adherence_score FROM s LEFT JOIN te ON te.pat_eth IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.pat_eth LEFT JOIN ta ON ta.pat_eth IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.pat_eth ORDER BY s.pat_eth

WITH tes AS ( SELECT e.fac_id, AVG(CASE tb.th_eng WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 END) AS tes FROM encounters e JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key GROUP BY e.fac_id ), outc AS ( SELECT e.fac_id, AVG(CASE lower(t.txprogmet->>'Func_Impv') WHEN 'significant' THEN 3 WHEN 'moderate' THEN 2 WHEN 'minimal' THEN 1 END) AS fis, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.txprogmet->>'Tx_Adh' IN ('High','Medium','Compliant'))::numeric / COUNT(*) AS tar FROM treatmentoutcomes t JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.tx_key = t.tx_ref JOIN encounters e ON e.enc_key = tb.enc_ref GROUP BY e.fac_id ) SELECT te.fac_id AS facility_id, ROUND(te.tes, 2) AS avg_tes, ROUND(o.fis * o.tar, 2) AS rti FROM tes te JOIN outc o ON o.fac_id = te.fac_id WHERE te.tes > 2.0 AND o.fis * o.tar < 0.8 ORDER BY te.fac_id LIMIT 100
